scripts.dev: APP_URL=http://localhost:3000 API_URL=http://localhost:4000 LANDING_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bun run view && bun run icon && APP_URL=http://localhost:3000 API_URL=http://localhost:4000 bunx --bun electrobun dev
scripts.view: bun run sdk && bunx --bun vite build
scripts.package: : "${APP_URL:?set APP_URL to the web app URL}" "${API_URL:?set API_URL to the API URL}" "${LANDING_URL:?set LANDING_URL to the landing URL}" && bun run view && bun run icon && bunx --bun electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.typecheck: bun run sdk && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.page.json
